findings.summary: Canonical --require-ready ignores index/worktree state. Staged, unstaged and untracked capability/governance bytes can be present while committed-diff validation reports READY.

The metadata allowlist does not require review_registry.json or acceptance_decision.json to be regular Git blobs. A committed mode-120000 review-registry symlink to an external mutable JSON payload passed canonical READY.
The committed regular-file allowlist rejects out-of-scope modifications, rename, deletion and malicious merge ancestry.
Empty exclusive instants and recursively empty alternatives fail.
Spatial refine/add_alternative and literal correct preserve predecessor valid_time.
Lifecycle contradictions and duplicate review/finding identifiers fail closed.

commands: verify remote PR head, branch, commit and tree
controlled staged, unstaged, untracked and ignored-path attacks
conclusion: Round 7 closes the earlier committed-path and lifecycle findings, but canonical READY can ignore non-HEAD worktree bytes and can externalize control metadata through a symlink. The validator-integrity decision is CHANGES_REQUIRED.
